items.label: Wrong case
items.description: The ending belongs to a different case from the one the context requires.

items.label: Left in the nominative
items.description: The word was left in its dictionary form where an inflected form is required, the most common English-speaker habit, because English nouns barely change.

items.label: Accusative instead of prepositional
items.description: в/на + accusative means motion into/onto (куда́?); location (где?) needs the prepositional.

items.label: Prepositional instead of accusative
items.description: Motion towards a place (куда́?) takes в/на + accusative, not the prepositional.

items.label: Missing genitive of negation
items.description: нет / не бы́ло / не бу́дет + the absent thing takes the genitive.

items.label: Missing genitive after a quantity
items.description: Numbers 2–4 take genitive singular, 5+ and мно́го/ма́ло/ско́лько take genitive plural.

items.label: Wrong case for this preposition
items.description: Each preposition governs a fixed case (or two, with a change in meaning).

items.label: Wrong case for this verb
items.description: Some verbs govern a non-accusative object: помога́ть + dat, занима́ться + ins, боя́ться + gen.

items.label: Missing instrumental
items.description: Instrument (писа́ть ру́чкой), с + companion, быть/стать + profession, and many verbs take the instrumental.

items.label: Right case, wrong number
items.description: The case is correct but singular/plural is not.

items.label: Wrong declension class
items.description: The ending belongs to another gender's pattern (e.g. a feminine -ь noun declined like a masculine).

items.label: Adjective/pronoun gender mismatch
items.description: Adjectives, possessives and past-tense verbs must match the noun's gender.

items.label: Adjective case mismatch
items.description: The adjective must be in the same case as its noun.

items.label: Animacy in the accusative
items.description: Masculine animate nouns (and all animate plurals) take a genitive-looking accusative: ви́жу бра́та, ви́жу студе́нтов.

items.label: Spelling rule: и not ы
items.description: After к, г, х, ж, ш, щ, ч write и, never ы (кни́ги, not ~~книгы~~).

items.label: Spelling rule: unstressed е not о
items.description: After ж, ш, щ, ч, ц an unstressed о is written е (ме́сяцем, but отцо́м).

items.label: Spelling rule: а/у not я/ю
items.description: After к, г, х, ж, ш, щ, ч, ц write а and у, not я and ю (слы́шат, кричу́).

items.label: Soft sign error
items.description: A missing or extra ь (e.g. -ться vs -тся, ночь vs мяч).

items.label: Fleeting vowel
items.description: The о/е that disappears (оте́ц → отца́) or appears (окно́ → о́кон) was handled wrongly.

items.label: ё/е
items.description: Accepted, but note the ё (and so the stress).

items.label: Typo in the stem
items.description: One letter off in the stem: accepted with a note. Endings are never typo-tolerated.

items.label: Non-existent ending
items.description: No case/number of this word has this ending.

items.label: Wrong person/number
items.description: The verb ending does not match the subject (я → -у/-ю, ты → -ешь/-ишь, ...).

items.label: Wrong conjugation
items.description: 1st-conjugation ending on a 2nd-conjugation verb or vice versa (-ешь vs -ишь, -ут vs -ат).

items.label: Missing consonant change
items.description: Mutations like писа́ть → пишу́, ви́деть → ви́жу, люби́ть → люблю́ were missed or misplaced.

items.label: Past tense gender
items.description: The past tense agrees in gender with the subject: он чита́л, она́ чита́ла.

items.label: Reflexive -ся
items.description: -ся/-сь missing, extra, or the wrong one (-сь after vowels, -ся after consonants).

items.label: Wrong aspect
items.description: Process/repetition/attempt → imperfective; single completed result → perfective.

items.label: бу́ду + perfective
items.description: The compound future (бу́ду + infinitive) is only for imperfectives; a perfective's present-tense form already means the future.

items.label: Aspect after negation
items.description: Negated imperatives and не на́до usually take the imperfective.

items.label: Uni- vs multidirectional
items.description: идти́/е́хать: one trip in one direction now; ходи́ть/е́здить: round trips, habits, wandering.

items.label: On foot vs by vehicle
items.description: идти́/ходи́ть on foot; е́хать/е́здить by transport.

items.label: Wrong motion prefix
items.description: при- arrive, у- leave, в- enter, вы- exit, под- approach, от- move away, до- reach, пере- cross, про- pass, за- drop in, об- go round, с- descend, раз- disperse.

items.label: где vs куда́ vs отку́да
items.description: Location (где) vs destination (куда́) vs origin (отку́да) need different cases and adverbs.

items.label: Number + noun form
items.description: 1 → nom sg; 2/3/4 → gen sg; 5–20 → gen pl; then by the last digit.

items.label: Numeral not declined
items.description: Numerals themselves decline: о пяти́ кни́гах, с двумя́ друзья́ми.

items.label: Pronoun form
items.description: Wrong case of a personal pronoun, or a missing н- after a preposition (с ним, у неё).

items.label: свой vs его́/её
items.description: свой refers back to the subject; его́/её/их refer to someone else.

items.label: Wrong stress
items.description: The stressed vowel is elsewhere; stress often moves within a paradigm (рука́ → ру́ку).

items.label: Different word
items.description: A real word, but not the one meant.

items.label: False friend
items.description: Looks like an English word but means something else (магази́н = shop, not magazine).
